player_prompt.intro:
I Stratego-ah Player {player_id} i ni.
I tum ber chu i khingpui Flag emaw, an piece sawi theih zawng zawng emaw i lakluh a ni.
I sipai te chu board-ah i tan dah a ni tawh, Flag, Bomb, leh piece dangte pawh rank hrang hrang neiin.

### Gameplay Instructions
1. **Movement Rules:**
   - I turn-ah chuan piece pakhat i sawi thei, a thawl khat i sawi thei a, square pawn lam (up, down, left, or right) ah i sawi thei a, i piece ngei a awm tawh kher a ni.
   - Example: Piece pakhat chuan A1 atangin B1 emaw, A1 atangin A2 ah i sawi thei a, B1 leh A2 ah i piece ngei a awm loh chuan.
   - I thlan piece chu Bomb emaw, Flag emaw a nih chuan i sawi thei lo.
2. **Battles:**
   - I sawi a, khingpui piece a awmna square-ah chuan inbeihna a awm ang:
     - Rank sang zawk piece chuan a chak a, khingpui piece a lakluh.
     - Rank a inang chuan piece pahnih a lak a ni.
     - **Special Cases:**
       - Bomb chuan a lakluh a, Miner chuan Bomb a tichhe thei.
       - Spy chuan Marshal a hneh thei a, Spy in a hmasa a, a chak a, a thua leh piece dang zawng zawng.
3. **Strategic Goals:**
   - I khingpui piece te i hriat a, an movement leh inbeihna atangin.
   - I Flag i ven a, i khingpui Flag i lakluh tum a.
   - Scout i hmang fai a, i khingpui piece te i hriat a, a hneh theih loh piece i bei.

### How to Make a Move:
1. I sawi duh piece leh a kalna i sawi.
2. Format hman tur: [A0 B0], A0 chu source position a ni a, B0 chu destination a ni.
   - Example: Piece pakhat i sawi a, row 0, column 0 atangin row 1, column 0 ah i sawi a, input [A0 B0].
3. Destination a valid a, movement rules a zulzui a ni.

### Important Notes:
- Board chuan i piece leh an position a show ang, e.g. MN, MS.
- Board chuan i khingpui piece position a show bawk a, an rank a show lo, e.g. ?.
- ~ a awmna grid chu dil a ni a, a sawi theih loh.
- Suggestion: I game i tan a, i piece i sawi a, front line-ah a awm a, i khingpui piece i hriat a. Player 0 leh player 1 front line chu row D leh G a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action format a dik lo. Player {player_id} chuan move a input format [A0 B0] a hmang lo.

invalid_move.not_own_piece: Action format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan mahni piece pakhat a thlak tur a ni.
invalid_move.scout_through_pieces: Action format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan scout chu piece dangin a thlak thei lo.
invalid_move.scout_diagonal: Action format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan scout chu a diagonal-a sawn thei lo ang.
invalid_move.non_scout_multi_square: Thiltih dan dik loh. Scout tih loh piece dangte chuan vawi khat ah square khat chiah an kal thei.
invalid_move.move_into_lake: Action format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan lake-ah a lut thei lo ang.
invalid_move.move_onto_own_piece: Action format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan mahni piece-ah a lut thei lo.
invalid_move.move_bomb_or_flag: Action format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan bomb emaw, flag emaw a hnutchhiah thei lo ang.
